metadata.title: Indonesia Data Center Database
metadata.notes: Capacity figures represent IT load capacity where available. Some facilities lack public MW disclosures. Updated 2026-03-15 following cross-reference against BKPM tax holiday recipient list.
changelog: 2026-03-15: Added NTT Global Data Centers Indonesia, GDS/DayOne (Batam), Digital Realty Bersama/BDDC, DCI Indonesia E1, K2 Data Centres/Sinarmas Land, Bitera/MIG, Korea Investment/Sinar Mas (KMG) as new entries. Corrected Digital Edge entry to capture existing Jakarta facilities. Split and corrected the erroneous 'Korea Investment Partners / Sinar Mas Land + Digital Realty / Mitra Aditama' compound entry. Added PT entity cross-references for tax holiday linkage.

major_investments.pt_entity: PT Ekagrata Data Gemilang (via PT Indointernet Tbk, IDX: EDGE)
major_investments.notes: Future campus. Existing Jakarta operations (EDGE1 6 MW Kuningan + EDGE2 23 MW South Jakarta, total 29 MW, USD 490M invested) are held under the same PT entity but are a separate, operational asset. USD 325M BCA credit facility secured 2024 for EDGE2 completion and next build.

major_investments.pt_entity: PT Ekagrata Data Gemilang (via PT Indointernet Tbk, IDX: EDGE)
major_investments.notes: EDGE2 was the largest data center in Jakarta metro at launch (February 2024). USD 165M acquisition of Indonet (2021) + USD 325M BCA credit facility (2024).

major_investments.pt_entity: PT Datacenter Indonesia Sukses Makmur (JV: PT DCI Indonesia Tbk IDX:DCII + Salim Group)

locations.notes: First solar-powered DC in Indonesia (30 MW solar over 30 ha)

major_investments.notes: 86-hectare campus at Pertiwi Lestari Industrial Estate (Salim Group-owned land). Long-term 600 MW potential. DCII group capex IDR 883B (2024), IDR ~2T/yr budgeted 2025-2026.

major_investments.pt_entity: PT Datacenter Indonesia Sukses Perkasa (JV: PT DCI Indonesia Tbk IDX:DCII + Salim Group)

locations.address: Ariobimo Sentral, Jl. HR Rasuna Said, Kuningan, South Jakarta

major_investments.notes: First Tier-IV certified data center in central Jakarta. Described as Southeast Asia's first AI-equipped Tier-IV data center. Uptime Institute Tier-IV certified.

major_investments.pt_entity: PT NTT Global Data Centers Indonesia (also: PT NTT Indonesia Nexcenter)
major_investments.project: JKT1 / JKT2 / JKT2A / JKT3 Campus Portfolio
major_investments.timeline: Operational since 2015 (Cyber CSF acquisition); JKT2A opening Q1 2026

locations.address: Wisma 46, Jl. Jend. Sudirman Kav. 1, Jakarta
Cyber Building 1, Jl. Kuningan Barat No. 8, South Jakarta

major_investments.parent: NTT Corp (Japan, TYO: 9432) via NTT Global Data Centers Corp (NTT Com 60%, NTT Urban Dev 20%, NTT Corp 10%, NTT Finance 10%)
major_investments.notes: Founding member of IDPRO. In Indonesia since 2015 (acquired PT Cyber CSF). USD 500M investment commitment for JKT3 (announced 2019). Part of USD 10B+ global NTT DATA capex plan 2023-2027. Significant dataset gap: NTT had ~70 MW operational before this update.

major_investments.pt_entity: PT GDS IDC Service (70% GDS/DayOne via GDS IDC Services Pte. Ltd. Singapore; 30% PT Maleo Investasi Indonesia)
major_investments.timeline: Groundbreaking July 2023; financing closed June 2025; completion targeted end-2025

locations.address: Nongsa Digital Park (SEZ), Batam, Riau Islands
locations.notes: ~25 km from Singapore; within Batam SEZ

major_investments.jv_partner: Indonesia Investment Authority (INA, sovereign wealth fund) — formalized October 2023 in presence of President Joko Widodo
major_investments.financing: IDR 6.7 trillion (~USD 412M) syndicated loan from DBS + UOB (June 2025) — largest rupiah-denominated datacenter loan on record
major_investments.parent: GDS Holdings Limited (NASDAQ: GDS; HKEX: 9698) via DayOne (formerly GDS International)
major_investments.notes: All Indonesia operations in Batam SEZ. Batam chosen for proximity to Singapore (~25 km) and SEZ incentives. Earlier Rp 4 trillion investment cited by Indonesian govt (July 2023). INA participation in DayOne Series C (USD 2B+ round). Significant dataset gap: Batam entirely absent from prior dataset despite 21.7% CAGR flagged in market summary.

major_investments.pt_entity: PT PCDC Propco One (originally SpaceDC; now held by BDDC / Bersama Digital Infrastructure Asia)
major_investments.timeline: Operational (SpaceDC origin); BDDC acquired 2023; Digital Realty JV 2025

locations.address: Jalan Daan Mogot KM 18, Kalideres, West Jakarta
locations.notes: Uptime Institute Tier III certified. Originally SpaceDC JAK2.

major_investments.ownership_chain: SpaceDC (GIC-backed) → AtriaDC/Saratoga Investama (IDX: SRTG) → BDDC / BDIA (Macquarie Asset Management + Saratoga + Provident Capital) → Digital Realty Bersama (Digital Realty 50:50 JV with BDIA, ~USD 100M contribution, 2025)
major_investments.notes: BDDC's full two-site platform (JBT1 + JST) targets 60 MW combined / ~USD 600M full buildout. Digital Realty's entry into Indonesia is through this JV, not a greenfield build. No connection to Princeton Digital Group.

major_investments.timeline: JKT1 Phase 1 online early 2024; Karawang pipeline

locations.address: Kota Deltamas, Bekasi Regency, West Java
locations.certification: Uptime Institute Tier III, LEED Gold

locations.address: Karawang Regency, West Java (land acquired from PT Suryacipta Swadaya)

major_investments.parent: Kuok Group (Malaysia) — K2 Data Centres est. 2017. 'K' = Kuok, 'ID' = Indonesia. No Korean affiliation.
major_investments.jv_partner: Sinarmas Land Limited (SGX-listed property arm of Sinar Mas Group Indonesia)
major_investments.regional_plan: USD 9B investment plan across Malaysia, Indonesia, Thailand over 5 years; USD 1B deployed to date
major_investments.notes: Formerly mislabeled in dataset as 'Korea Investment Partners / Sinar Mas Land'. K2/Sinarmas Land and Korea Investment/Sinar Mas are entirely separate JVs. Sinar Mas has two distinct datacenter JV relationships.

major_investments.parent: 50:50 JV: Korea Investment Real Asset Management Co. (unit of Korea Investment Holdings, South Korea) + Sinar Mas Group (Indonesia)
major_investments.equity_structure: ~USD 53M each (70 billion won); plus 260 billion won project financing. Total ~USD 300M (400 billion won).
major_investments.tenant: LG CNS (via LG Sinarmas Technology Solutions JV) signed to build hyperscale AI datacenter starting at 30 MW scalable to 220 MW
major_investments.notes: Newly added; previously absent from dataset. This is the correct entity linked to 'Korea Investment + Sinar Mas' — separate from K2/Sinarmas Land. Tax holiday status unconfirmed as of March 2026.

major_investments.parent: MMS Group Indonesia (100% domestic; founder Andrew Hidayat). Three business pillars: MMS Resources, MMS Land, MMS Solution.
major_investments.power: 59.8 MVA PLN 'Ultimate' service; 100% renewable via PLN RECs
major_investments.notes: 100% domestically-owned operator. Grand launch attended by Minister of Investment Bahlil Lahadalia and Minister of SOEs Erick Thohir. J Trust Bank syndicated credit financing. No connection to Digital Realty 'Mitra Aditama' reference found in prior market research — that reference appears to be a data error.

major_investments.status: Unknown — entity unverifiable from public sources
major_investments.notes: Tax holiday confirmed by government list, but no public data found on Baxtel, DataCenterMap, DataCenterDynamics, or Indonesian media. May be newly incorporated, operating under a different trade name, or a very small/private operator. Direct registry query via ahu.go.id or oss.go.id recommended to verify.
MNC subject to OECD Pillar Two; tax holiday benefit may be substantially offset by home-country top-up tax.
PDG's Indonesian entity is 'PT Princeton Digital Group Data Centers'. No connection to PT PCDC Propco One.

tax_holiday.eligible_sectors: 18 pioneer industries including data centers and digital infrastructure
tax_holiday.transition_benefit: 50% CIT reduction for 2 additional years after holiday ends
tax_holiday.oecd_pillar_two_impact: Domestic top-up tax applies to MNEs subject to 15% global minimum

other_incentives.investment_allowance: 30% of total investment deductible over 6 years

estimated_dc_sector_tax_expenditure.methodology: Bottom-up estimate based on known investments and tax holiday parameters
estimated_dc_sector_tax_expenditure.notes: Estimate assumes all major investments qualify for 100% tax holiday. Actual foregone revenue depends on profitability timelines, depreciation schedules, and OECD Pillar Two adjustments. Conservative estimate. Does not yet incorporate NTT (USD 500M+), GDS/DayOne (USD 412M), or K2/Sinarmas (part of USD 9B regional plan) investments confirmed as tax holiday recipients in March 2026 update — revised estimate pending.
